# Simulated cost/quality records

Every amount, duration, candidate, review and outcome in `matched.json` is invented
test data. It is not live execution, billing, independent review or measured savings.
`expected.json` is a manually curated arithmetic oracle, never generated by the
evaluator.

Plain's three attempt totals are USD 4 + 6 + 4 = 14. One of two final task results
is independently accepted in the fixture: 14 / 1 = 14. Cheap-first's totals are
USD 2 + 2 + 4 = 8, with two accepted final results: 8 / 2 = 4. Each strategy has
one retry. Plain records two failures and one false acceptance; cheap-first records
one failure and zero false acceptances. Attempt durations sum to 40 and 20 seconds.

The failed final plain attempt deliberately claims acceptance, while its separate
review records refusal. Candidate labels cannot override the external record.
Tests mutate copies to exercise missing/partial costs, zero acceptance, unknown or
self-authored reviews, stale bindings, incomplete inventories and incomparable runs.
No original fixture evidence is edited by evaluation or replay.
